eyebrow: Creating a workspace from the Azure CLI
code:
az extension add --name quantum

az group create \
  --name rg-quantum-dev \
  --location eastus

az quantum workspace create \
  --resource-group rg-quantum-dev \
  --workspace-name qsharp-dev-workspace \
  --location eastus \
  --storage-account mystoragelinked \
  --provider-sku-list "microsoft-elements.full-state-simulator:microsoft-elements,microsoft.estimator:microsoft-elements"
caption: --provider-sku-list is where you declare which providers and plan tiers this workspace gets access to.

code:
from azure.quantum import Workspace

workspace = Workspace(
    subscription_id="<subscription-id>",
    resource_group="rg-quantum-dev",
    name="qsharp-dev-workspace",
    location="eastus",
)
caption: Authentication goes through your existing Azure credentials — no separate Azure Quantum API keys to manage.
